newsitem.title: USA: Country Maid signs egg breaking pact.
newsitem.headline: Country Maid signs egg breaking pact.

text.p: Country Maid Foods Inc said Tuesday it signed an agreement calling for Rose Acres Inc of Seymour, Indiana, to process its eggs for distribution into the growing egg-products market.
The contract will allow Country Maid to expand its presence in the egg products market, which includes dried, frozen and liquid eggs, the company said.
Country Maid is a holding company specializing in egg production and other agricultural-related entities.
